[P2] 鼻孔的故事
柳生弦一郎 文·图

你在看这本书的
时候，要把鼻孔张
大了来念喔！

中国少年儿童出版社

[P3] 和小美比起来，我的鼻孔比较大。

[P4] 但是，和祖父一比，我的鼻孔就没有他的大了。
是不是等我长到像祖父
一样老的时候，鼻孔也
会变得那么大呢？
想起来
真有点怕怕的。

[P5] 每一个人，鼻孔的大小和形状都不一样。
来！大家把头抬起来，
让小朋友仔细看看
你们的鼻孔。
喂！当胡子的伯伯
嘴巴不必张开。
我不用抬头，
你也能看得清楚
我的鼻孔。

[P6] 大部分的动物，都有两个鼻孔。
大象
马
乌龟
狗
骆驼
野猪
不过，有些动物，只有
一个鼻孔。
海豚的鼻孔只有一个，它长在头顶上。
在这里！

[P7] 海豹的鼻孔可以闭上。这样，它潜水的时候，水就不会跑进鼻孔了。
河马的鼻孔也一样。当它浮出水面，鼻孔会张开；当它潜入水底，鼻孔就闭上。真方便。
我们的鼻孔，也会稍微张开和合拢。

[P8] 我们用鼻孔吸入和呼出空气。这是鼻孔最重要的功能。
当然，我们也可以张开嘴巴呼吸空气。
水壶盖上的小孔，用处和鼻孔是不是一样呢？

[P9] 臭臭！
如果鼻孔塞住了，
我们就闻不到气味。
感冒流鼻涕，
就闻不到臭味，
bu
bu
bu
好臭啊！

[P10] 鼻孔塞住时，说话会含混不清。
鼻涕越来越多，糟糕！
要流出来了。对不起呀！
因为鼻孔塞住了，我们就没办法把“a、e、o、ye、ai、ei、ao、ou”这些声音念清楚。你可以自己捏住鼻子试试看。

[P11] 鼻孔里有鼻毛，它会挡住空气中的灰尘，
让脏东西跑不进我们的身体。

虽然鼻毛用不着修剪，
但是也不要像这位伯伯
留得这么长。

有时打喷嚏，把跑进
鼻孔的脏东西喷出来。

鼻孔里有鼻屎。鼻屎是由灰尘
和鼻涕混合成的，像个小圆球。

灰尘
→渐渐地混在一起
→鼻屎

鼻涕

因为鼻屎里有很多灰尘，
所以很脏。就算像下面一样
排列得整整齐齐，还是很脏。

[P12] 鼻孔里经常有水分，所以是潮湿的。感冒的时候，鼻水比平常多，有时就会自己流出来。

你们看！大猩猩
流鼻涕了，
要不要卫生纸？
不要！
为什么？
干了可以
拿下来
吃！
哎哟！
好恶心！

如果你乱挖鼻孔，是会流鼻血的！
kou
kou
kou

[P13] 糟糕！流鼻血了。

流鼻血，有许多原因。

鼻子碰伤了
会流鼻血。
有时候，你静静地
不动，也流鼻血。

通常流鼻血，最多十分钟就会自动停止。
假如一直流个不停，你就应该去看医生了。

[P14] 鼻子里面是什么样子？

我们有两个鼻孔，所以鼻子
里头也分成两条通道。

鼻腔和口腔
最后会连在一起。

鼻子里面布满许多形状奇怪的颗粒，
凹凹凸凸的。空气就从这凹凸不平的
表面通过。

右边的鼻孔

鼻毛
嘴巴

鼻腔内部
口腔
舌头
喉咙

这个地方的组织，可以让我们感觉到
各种气味。

从鼻孔进来的冷空气，
在这里加温，干燥的空气，
也会在这里变得湿润。

这里有一个管子，
可以通到耳朵里面。

[P15] 鼻孔很重要，所以不要把豆子、铅笔等东西塞进鼻孔。

不可以
哟！

好像
不可以

如果把牵牛花的种子塞进鼻孔，
种子会慢慢膨胀、发芽。
鼻子就会痛。好可怕呀！

耳朵的洞、
嘴巴的洞、
屁股的洞、
小便的洞等等。
这些洞对我们的身体
都很重要，所以
要常常保持清洁。

[P16] 如果鼻孔变成这样子，就完蛋啦！

[P2] The Story of Nostrils
By and Illustrated by Yusuke Yagyu

When you're reading this book,
you need to open your nostrils
wide and read it aloud!

China Children's Publishing House

[P3] Compared to Xiaomei, my nostrils are bigger.

[P4] But compared to Grandfather, my nostrils aren't as big as his.
Will my nostrils also become that big when I grow old like Grandfather?
Thinking about it,
I'm a bit scared.

[P5] Everyone's nostrils are different in size and shape.
Come on! Everyone, lift your heads up,
so the children can take a good look
at your nostrils.
Hey! The uncle with the mustache
doesn't need to open his mouth.
I don't need to lift my head,
you can still see my nostrils clearly.

[P6] Most animals have two nostrils.
Elephant
Horse
Turtle
Dog
Camel
Boar
However, some animals have only
one nostril.
The dolphin has only one nostril, and it is on top of its head.
Here it is!

[P7] Seals can close their nostrils. This way, when they dive underwater, water won't get into their nostrils.
Hippos are the same. When they surface, their nostrils open; when they dive to the bottom, their nostrils close. Very convenient.
Our nostrils also open and close slightly.

[P8] We use our nostrils to inhale and exhale air. This is the most important function of nostrils.
Of course, we can also breathe through our mouths.
Is the function of the small hole on the kettle lid the same as that of nostrils?

[P9] Yuck!
If our nostrils are blocked,
we can't smell anything.
When you have a cold and runny nose,
you can't smell bad odors,
bu
bu
bu
Yuck!

[P10] When your nostrils are blocked, your speech becomes muffled.
There's more and more snot, oh no!
It's about to come out. Sorry!
Because your nostrils are blocked, we can't pronounce sounds like "a, e, o, ye, ai, ei, ao, ou" clearly. You can try pinching your nose yourself.

[P11] Inside the nostrils, there are nasal hairs. They block dust in the air,
keeping dirty things from entering our bodies.

Although nasal hairs don't need trimming,
we shouldn't let them grow as long as this uncle's.

Sometimes, when you sneeze, the dirty things that entered
your nostrils are sprayed out.

Inside the nostrils, there is nasal mucus. Nasal mucus is made of dust
and mucus mixed together, like a small ball.

Dust
→ gradually mixed together
→ nasal mucus

Mucus

Because nasal mucus contains a lot of dust,
it's very dirty. Even if arranged neatly like below,
it's still dirty.

[P12] The inside of your nose often has moisture, so it's damp. When you have a cold, you produce more nasal fluid, which sometimes flows out on its own.

Look! The gorilla
has a runny nose.
Do you need tissue paper?
No!
Why?
You can
pick it off
and eat it!
Oh no!
How gross!

If you dig your nose carelessly, you might bleed!
kou
kou
kou

[P13] Oh no! I'm bleeding from my nose.

There are many reasons for a nosebleed.

If your nose gets hurt,
 you might bleed.
Sometimes, even if you're just sitting still,
 you can get a nosebleed.

Usually, a nosebleed will stop on its own within ten minutes.
If it keeps going, you should go see a doctor.

[P14] What does the inside of the nose look like?

We have two nostrils, so the inside of the nose is divided into two passages.

The nasal cavity and the oral cavity
will eventually connect together.

The inside of the nose is filled with many oddly shaped particles,
rough and uneven. Air passes through this uneven surface.

Right nostril

Nasal hair
Mouth

Inside the nasal cavity
Oral cavity
Tongue
Throat

The tissue in this area allows us to sense
various smells.

Cold air entering through the nostrils
is warmed here, and dry air
also becomes moist here.

There is a tube here
that can lead to the ear.

[P15] Nose holes are very important, so don't put beans, pencils, or other things into your nose.

No way!

Seems
not allowed

If you put a morning glory seed into your nose,
the seed will slowly swell and sprout.
Your nose will hurt. How scary!

The holes in our ears,
the holes in our mouths,
the holes in our bottoms,
the holes for peeing, and so on.
These holes are very important for our bodies,
so we must keep them clean all the time.

[P16] If your nostrils became like this, you'd be in big trouble!
full_summary_zh:
[P1] 本页为绘本《鼻孔的故事》的封面与封底，展示了书名、作者、出版社、ISBN、出版信息及阅读年龄建议，封底有两颗黑色圆点，封面为两个黑色圆形图案，象征鼻孔。
[P2] 本页为绘本《鼻孔的故事》的扉页，左侧是黑白圆点图案，右侧显示书名、作者及出版社信息，并有一个对话框提示读者阅读时要张大鼻孔。
[P3] 本页展示了两个孩子的面部特写，右侧孩子说自己的鼻孔比小美大，画面通过对比突出鼻孔大小的差异。
[P4] 孩子观察到祖父的鼻孔比自己大，开始担心自己长大后鼻孔也会变大，感到有些害怕。
[P5] 本页通过多个角色的面部特写，展示不同人鼻孔的大小和形状差异，并配有对话引导读者观察，强调鼻孔的多样性。
[P6] 本页通过左右两页对比，左侧展示大象、马、乌龟、狗、骆驼、野猪等动物的两个鼻孔，右侧介绍海豚只有一个鼻孔且长在头顶，并配有儿童在水中与海豚互动的画面，强调动物鼻孔数量和位置的多样性。
[P7] 本页通过海豹和河马的例子说明它们的鼻孔可以随潜水状态开合，避免进水，并类比指出人类的鼻孔也会轻微张开和合拢。
[P8] 本页通过左右两页对比，左侧展示一个角色在橙色背景中呼吸，强调鼻孔吸入和呼出空气的功能；右侧描绘一个孩子在餐桌前吃饭，提示嘴巴也可呼吸，并通过对话框引导读者思考水壶盖小孔与鼻孔功能的相似性。
[P9] 本页通过孩子和猫的反应，说明鼻孔堵塞时无法闻到气味，强调了鼻孔在嗅觉中的重要作用。
[P10] 本页通过一个流鼻涕的孩子和三个捏住鼻子的孩子，说明鼻孔堵塞会影响说话清晰度，并引导读者通过捏住鼻子体验这一现象。
[P11] 本页通过图文结合的方式，解释了鼻毛和鼻屎的形成与作用，说明鼻毛能阻挡灰尘，鼻屎由灰尘和鼻涕混合而成，并通过打喷嚏排出脏物，强调了鼻孔内部清洁机制的重要性。
[P12] 本页通过大猩猩流鼻涕的插图和对话，说明鼻水在感冒时会增多并自然流出；同时通过孩子挖鼻孔的图画和文字警告乱挖鼻孔会导致流鼻血，强调鼻孔的生理状态和不当行为的后果。
[P13] 本页通过左右两页对比，左侧展示一个流鼻血的孩子，右侧通过棒球场景解释流鼻血的多种原因，并说明通常会自行停止，若持续则需就医。
[P14] 本页通过图文结合的方式，解释了鼻腔内部的结构，包括两条通道、鼻毛、鼻腔与口腔的连接，以及鼻腔内组织对气味的感知和对空气的加温湿润作用，并指出鼻腔内有通向耳朵的管子。
[P15] 本页通过图文说明鼻孔的重要性，警告不要将异物塞入鼻孔，并用牵牛花种子的例子说明可能的危险；同时扩展到身体其他孔洞，强调保持清洁的必要性。
[P16] 本页通过一个骷髅形象的插图，警示如果鼻孔被堵塞或受损，将带来严重后果，强调鼻孔健康的重要性。
